parameter_groups.determination: 原工程设定。S03数值例使用30km/h及3/5辆，不校准本项目；S01原波次1h。新业务需容量单位、车队/需求与装卸数据。
D2为全就绪宽TW快照。与原道路时间矩阵竞赛、原CVRP规模/需求分布不同；新动态数据独立注册，不事后筛日。
工程权重/相对价值。论文不提供该数值；无元/kg、驾驶工资、售价和品质降价映射的业务校准。
目标对应选定参考条件，非各品类通用最优温度；硬界是pilot，食品品质论文不直接证明全部硬界或安全合规。

parameter_groups.values: 环境25°C；昼变幅6°C；相位14h；发车延迟0
parameter_groups.determination: 环境曲线为pilot，需地点、时段与实测/外部天气资料；不能由论文泛称环境影响确定系数。
车型/隔热/装载与舱室参数未标定；需闭门升温或传热识别，并区分货物与空气温度。
全部pilot。制冷输出=电功率×COP须与热容/传热协调，独立降温率需明确经验近似和适用范围。
门次数/持续时间/装载影响需实测；是否占空舱也冷却、返仓再发是否付预冷费必须注册。

parameter_groups.family: 继承但未证实际激活的预冷配置
parameter_groups.determination: 继承字段存在不等于delivery evaluator实际调用。新合同先做字段→执行路径核查，不把未启用参数当已实施功能。
番茄内插、鲻鱼参考拟合、海鲈鱼外推约600天近似。固定速率没有实时温度输入；初始货龄/产品匹配需冻结。
D2注册范围保持。动态等待与复用必须另定义从仓庫至交付连续品质，省略仓库成本须有政策不变证明。

项目适配/身份选择。论文p=保留比例，不能以同样0.3宣称完全照用；guide和随机种子未获业务最优性证据。

original_readonly_D2_protocol.authorization: User requested independent delivery contract/baselines, same-initial-route equal-budget pilot, positive-clue-only online full validation
original_readonly_D2_protocol.activation: Delivery contract and baseline engineering QA plus actual pretrained encoder/decoder and same-architecture random control QA pass; freeze full runner closure before creating development instances
original_readonly_D2_protocol.parameter_scope: pilot physics references, not calibrated operational evidence

dataset.origin: new synthetic delivery-only instances; no pickup teacher or results reused
dataset.independent_unit: one newly generated route snapshot per instance_id, no repeated solver runs counted as new instances
dataset.generator: numpy PCG64 SeedSequence([seed,instance_id]); customer coords uniform [0,10]^2 km; depot [5,5]; integer demands uniform 1..5; temp_class uniform 0..2
dataset.time_window_scope: broad windows in first route-transfer pilot; does not establish performance under tight TW or dynamic release
dataset.same_initial_routes: five fixed customer-ID blocks [1..10],[11..20],[21..30],[31..40],[41..50], same order; independently certify all 32 before running any improvement arm
dataset.final_holdout: not generated or accessed by this pilot; online development/final sets require a separate declaration

weights.use: full original CVRP encoder and decoder; no I3 actor; no adaptation training

excluded_common_setup: fixed synthetic 51-node JIT prewarm of both actual and random models
timing.hardware: same pinned CPU54, BLAS and OMP one thread, no GPU allocation
timing.method_uses_less_than_limit: report actual wall time; unused budget is not credited as additional gain
timing.late_submission: common initial certified route fallback, count timeout; do not drop instance
timing.arm_order: fixed numpy SeedSequence([seed,instance_id,999]) permutation of five improvement arms, recorded per instance

reconstruction.mask: uniform customer subset ceil(0.3*N); only original nonremoved edges retained, no shortcut edges as model observations
reconstruction.retained_edges: cannot be removed by insertion within a reconstruction cycle
reconstruction.insertion_score: distance_delta / instance mean offdiagonal distance - guide_weight * logit_delta / offdiagonal logit std
reconstruction.single: one masked decode-reconstruct candidate; choose common incumbent or lower full contract cost
reconstruction.iterative: same weights and score; repeatedly remask current best while total deadline allows; no training difference
reconstruction.seed: SeedSequence([dataset.seed,instance_id,41]); same mask stream in pretrained single/iteration and random single

baseline.ortools: same initial assignment, distance GLS proposals with capacity/TW dimensions; independently certify and select by full cold-chain contract objective
baseline.lns: same initial routes, random customer removal max(2,N//5), regret-2 distance insertion, annealed current route, full cold-chain certified best
baseline.scope: two runnable classical search candidates; neither called validated online SOTA or HGS/ALNS

original_readonly_D2_protocol.main_metric: fractional cost gain (control_cost - method_cost) / control_cost; lower full contract cost is better
original_readonly_D2_protocol.pilot_pass: maskco_single mean fractional gain >=1% and CI lower>0 against EACH of OR-Tools and regret-LNS; also positive mean and CI lower>0 against same-architecture random single; all six arms hard=1, exactly 32 unique finite paired instances, full source/contract/data/weight/timing identity and source_start=source_end
original_readonly_D2_protocol.failure_branch: retain all instances/attempts and diagnose; no threshold/weight/budget/checkpoint/instance/seed adjustment or automatic rerun for better means; no delivery online full run
original_readonly_D2_protocol.success_branch: qualified route-transfer clue only; separately preregister and implement real delivery wave/fleet/cargo online contract and strong rolling controls before online full validation

quality_provenance_arithmetic.scope: Unit/provenance arithmetic only; no scientific experiment, parameter replacement or thermal calibration.

remaining_barriers: business scope and finite-fleet feasible generator
physical compartment and calibrated thermal/product response
strong finite multi-trip cold-chain controller adaptation
